  • Realizar passagem de plantão no início e final do turno, descrevendo o quadro clínico no atendimento.

title: Community Manager, Latin America
description:
Welcome to the Management Commons Job Board! Below you will find career opportunities with dynamic fiscal sponsors and other innovative organizations!

Administrative Customer Service Education/Training Finance Human Resources Management Non-Profit/Volunteering Leadership Strategic Planning Advocacy

Job Type :
Full Time

Work Location:
Remote

About the Job

The ImPactis a US-based nonprofit organization with team members spread around the world.We are looking for a Community Manager to lead the growth and support of our member community in Latin America. This is a remote full-time position and we are looking for candidates based in Brazil, Chile, or Mexico.

As a Community Manager, you will work with our members and other ImPact team members to inspire, support, and co-create action – both individually and collectively – to increase the flow of capital towards impact. The Community Manager will report to The ImPact’s Director of Community based in Santiago, Chile and will work closely with the Senior Director for community growth and support.

The Community Manager for Latin America will develop a vision and strategy for The ImPact’s community growth, support, and engagement with the surrounding impact ecosystem in the region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global vision and strategy. The Community Manager for Latin America will be responsible for developing a financial and operational plan pursuant to the regional vision and strategy, including the gathering of mission-aligned revenues alongside member contributions. The Community Manager for Latin America will also design and deliver individual support and collaborative experiences for the members in their region to help them make more impact investing more effectively. Overall, the Community Manager for Latin America is responsible and accountable for the setting and accomplishment of membership growth and engagement targets within their region, in alignment with The ImPact’s global goals.

We are a global, remote team with team members based in the US, France, Chile, and Singapore. We work across multiple time zones and our core ways of working are anchored in a combination of virtual synchronous meetings and asynchronous discussion and collaboration in writing and using other virtual collaborative tools. We also believe that consistent in-person connection and collaboration is important - for relationship building, team members’ professional growth, and effective work. Our global team meets in-person at least once a year at a team retreat or our global, annual member events.

The ImPact offers competitive salaried compensation, commensurate with experience and location, and generous benefits that vary by labor market.

Primary Responsibilities

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Relationship Management (40%): You will build strong and authentic relationships with all of The ImPact’s members based in Latin America, developing a deep understanding of their individual and family impact investment interests and areas of need. You will develop a customized plan of membership for each individual member that will provide the experiences, best practices, and relationships to support them in making progress towards their impact goals and have regular conversations with the members. You will forge connections among these members to best serve their individual and collective needs and facilitate peer-to-peer exchange of knowledge, data, and insights.
  • Member Recruitment (30%) : You will actively identify families who could benefit from and contribute to The ImPact’s unique peer-to-peer community through individual and collaborative outreach withThe ImPact’s global team and current members. You will work with the Director of Community to set regional growth targets and help open the funnel through distribution channel partnerships and participating in regional events. You are also responsible for the end-to-end recruitment process for prospective members, including assessing their initial interest and fit, coordinating the member endorsement process, supporting the formal invitation process, and conducting onboarding with new members.
  • Curation of Local & Global Experiences (25%): You will be responsible for developing a robust yearly calendar of experiences for members and prospective members in the region, selecting themes, curating content, and ensuring strong participation from members and prospective members. These experiences are designed to build lasting and productive relationships among members, provide knowledge and insights, and enable each participant to advance their own impact investing activities. You will also work with the global team to design, create, or adapt tools or other educational resources that deepen members’ knowledge of impact investing or enable them to take specific actions related to implementing their impact investment strategies.
  • Building Regional Strategy and Partnerships (5%) : You will set annual and quarterly Objectives and Key Results for Latin America as a whole. You will work closely with the Director of Community to build strong partnerships with organizations that can help advance The ImPact’s mission and relevance within Latin America..
  • Support team projects where needed .

Job Requirements

  • At least five years of experience in a relationship management role within a member services organization, a family office, or a family foundation
  • Demonstrated experience in and passion for community building and relationship management
  • Knowledge of the impact investment, private investment, and philanthropy ecosystems a plus
  • Social and emotional intelligence to effectively communicate and build authentic and lasting relationships across generations, cultures, national, and regional boundaries
  • Ability to “connect the dots” between diverse themes and people
  • A high level of discretion for both professional and personal affairs
  • Work independently and have the drive, patience, and resilience to get up a rapid learning curve and to build things from scratch
  • A desire to solve the world’s biggest problems and a belief in the power of impact investing to help do so
  • Ability to work harmoniously with a diverse team and comfort working independently with a remote team members across different time zones and using technology platforms
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, fluency in Portuguese language a plus
  • Flexibility to travel 20% of the time

Salary Range

USD

About the Organization

The ImPact is a global membership community, “by families, for families.” Families and their internal staff join The ImPact to learn with and from their peers how to align investment and philanthropic assets to create lasting positive change.

Our mission is to help families make more impact investments more effectively. For nearly 10 years, we have guided and supported families in the alignment of their values with all sources of family capital - philanthropic, investment, and family-owned businesses.

description:
Overview

Técnico de Enfermagem (CTI) – Rede Hospital Casa – Barra da Tijuca

Responsibilities

  • Realizar passagem de plantão no início e final do turno, descrevendo o quadro clínico no atendimento.
  • Cumprir a escala dos técnicos, elaborada pelo enfermeiro, na assistência aos pacientes (medicar, avaliar os sinais vitais, HGT).
  • Auxiliar na admissão do paciente realizando monitorização, cuidados de higiene, administração de medicações prescritas pelo médico e medidas de suporte avançado.
  • Realizar o balanço hídrico, checagem de todos os sinais vitais e descrever os testes do HGT.
  • Administrar a medicação dos pacientes e oferecer dieta oral e enteral de acordo com as prescrições.
  • Auxiliar médicos e enfermeiros em procedimentos. Realizar toda a higienização (corporal, oral e de baixo nível).
  • Atender as prescrições de medicamentos, buscar na farmácia a 2a via da solicitação, quando houver, acréscimos na prescrição. Realizar diariamente checagem do HGT e informar na planilha informações sobre a checagem.
  • Realizar, a cada turno, a conferência e teste dos equipamentos da sala de medicação.
  • Realizar curativo em paciente caso haja determinação do enfermeiro.
  • Desprezar diurese e secreções dos frascos de aspiração.
  • Verificar os materiais hospitalares, contagem e solicitar na farmácia a demanda.
  • Verificar a data de validade de cada medicamento e material a ser utilizado.
  • Comunicar ao médico ou enfermeiro qualquer tipo de alteração que o paciente venha a ter.
  • Providenciar troca de equipo a cada 96 horas.
  • Realizar punção venosa periférica. Datar a cabeceira do leito, em todos os materiais que o paciente está utilizando.
  • Conferir e testar o carrinho de emergência (medicações, instrumentos e materiais de dentro do carrinho somente quando há rompimento do lacre).
  • O que está por fora do carrinho é checado diariamente.
  • Buscar no CME materiais limpos, diariamente.
  • Organizar os expurgos do setor e garantir o acondicionamento seguro dos materiais contaminados.
  • Auxiliar na organização da unidade.
  • Em caso de óbito do paciente, realizar o preparo do corpo.

Qualifications

  • Mínimo de 1 ano na função
  • Coren ativo

Benefits

  • Refeição no Local
  • Convênio Médico

title: Engagement Manager
description:
Feedzai is the world’s first RiskOps platform for financial risk management, and the market leader in safeguarding global commerce with today’s most advanced cloud-based risk management platform, powered by machine learning and artificial intelligence. Feedzai is securing the transition to a cashless world while enabling digital trust in every transaction and payment type. The world’s largest banks, processors, and retailers trust Feedzai to protect trillions of dollars and manage risk while improving the customer experience for everyday users, without compromising privacy. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of +$1.5B, the company's technology protects 900 million people in 190 countries.

You:

Feedzai is looking for an Engagement Manager/Business Analyst who has strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills and demonstrates a strong passion for client success and product adoption. This role will serve as the leader for the delivery of the Order Form for our customers, which will include milestones such as defining the scope, stakeholder identification, data dictionary definition, and more.
You will combine product expertise with business acumen and general project management skills to lead the client through the implementation phase of each project. Being the client's primary point of contact, you should be able to coordinate multiple priorities and ensure the client can overcome any obstacles during the implementation process. You should continuously grow your professional skills through training, self-development, and by successfully guiding clients in integrating Feedzai’s products to prevent financial crime.

Your Day to Day:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for Feedzai’s customers and foster positive relationships with them;
  • Identify each client’s expectations and requirements and effectively communicate them across functional teams;
  • Become a subject matter expert of Feedzai’s products and advise clients about best practices;
  • Collaborate with the client with the support of Data Science and Risk Analyst teams to map the client’s fields to Feedzai’s standard API data dictionary;
  • Design process flows with an understanding of the customer’s event flow and current state;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams in a multicultural environment;
  • Address customer issues with speed and efficiency;
  • Perform project management tasks such as communicating the project status to both internal and external stakeholders, reminding clients about implementation milestones along with their due dates, facilitating meetings, taking meeting notes, and leading the product activation from start to finish;
  • Work with the portfolio manager to manage client backlog and understand client timelines;
  • Define and assess project risks and effectively devise mitigation plans;
  • Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product Management, Product Development, Portfolio Managers) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, and expansion opportunities;
  • Collaborate with the product and software development teams to ensure customer feedback is incorporated into our product roadmap;
  • Translate technical client requirements into user stories to be consumed by the Engineering team for implementation.

You Have & You Know-how:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Management, Engineering or similar field;
  • At least 2 years experience in a Business Analyst role with responsibility for requirement elicitation;
  • Familiarity with API mapping and design;
  • Demonstrated skills in managing customer relationships for a managed services and/or SaaS organization;
  • Project management experience, including the ability to effectively prioritize different clients’ deliverables;
  • Experience being hands-on with leading Customer Onboarding and Implementations;
  • Experience with the full Standard Development Lifecycle (SDLC);
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills;
  • Leadership, adaptability, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills;
  • Be solution-oriented and take initiative when issues arise;
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills;
  • Ability to manage client expectations and push back when necessary;
  • Experience leading workshops and project initiation meetings;
  • Experience with Visio or similar flowcharting software;
  • Understanding of data/schema definitions such as JSON and XML.

Your First 30-Days at Feedzai:

You will be immersed in our brand with training, connections, and one-on-one time with your manager. You may shadow your colleagues virtually or onsite at an office depending on where you work as you are supported through your Feedzai journey. In addition, you will have access to a ton of information to give you history, context, and all the knowledge you can handle about Feedzai and the team. Finally, you will start working on projects and collaborating on work currently being done. We can't wait to have you join the team!

O Coordenador poderá executar tarefas administrativas de Sistemas de Informação, e Finanças, incluindo formulários de processamento, elaboração de relatórios e monitoramento de orçamentos e prestar apoio geral a área. Fará uso de sistemas e recursos disponíveis para manter, rastrear e pesquisar dados e produzir e revisar relatórios. Fará aplicação de processos e práticas estabelecidos para melhorar a eficácia e documentar os procedimentos do programa de referência por parte dos funcionários. Coordenará atividades com múltiplas variáveis, definirá prazos realistas e fará o gerenciamento de cronograma.

O Coordenador será ponto de contato para consultas sobre as atividades do programa e poderá auxiliar no desenvolvimento de materiais de comunicação do programa e gerenciamento de correspondência. Esta posição trabalhará em cooperação com a equipe da Conservação, fornecendo informações necessárias para tomar decisões e resolver problemas. O Coordenador atuará como responsável pelo departamento conforme designado pela supervisão, a fim de coordenar arranjos, transmitir informações e garantir a execução bem-sucedida do programa direcionado relacionado à área funcional da equipe. O Coordenador implementará processos e práticas para melhorar a eficácia. O Coordenador e comunicará com a equipe de vários programas em toda a Conservancy, bem como com doadores, voluntários, fornecedores e relações comerciais. Ele comunicará ou distribuirá informações para ajudar a equipe a tomar decisões, resolver problemas e melhorar o fluxo de trabalho.

Estamos procurando por você:

Você está procurando um trabalho em que possa acreditar? Na TNC, nos esforçamos para incorporar uma filosofia de trabalho na qual você pode acreditar, onde você pode sentir que está fazendo a diferença todos os dias. Estamos procurando alguém com forte experiência em liderar uma equipe diversificada e multidisciplinar.

O candidato ideal deve ter habilidades de comunicação e colaboração e experiência em projetar, organizar e dirigir projetos complexos. Buscamos uma pessoa com perfil analítico, autônomo, curiosa, motivada por desafios e mudança diária de rotina e diversidade de atividades, que goste fundamentalmente de atender, tratar e orientar pessoas. Alguém com foco e domínio dos instrumentos, ferramentas e múltiplas linguagens existentes dentro da Organização. Profissional confiante, flexível e com empenho em revolver de forma proativa as situações e eventualidades com cotidiano. Que tenha interesse em se desenvolver e desenvolver os demais colegas de time e da TNC como um todo.

A área de Operações trabalha simultaneamente com temas diversos em alinhamento com diferentes áreas por toda a Organização. Assim, buscamos alguém com mente criativa, que se adapte facilmente a tratativa dos diversos temas, perfis e áreas. Que tenha sólida vivência em rotinas de facilidade, supervisão de pessoas, tratativa com público, negociações e fornecedores diversos, treinamentos, criação de processos, assim como entenda a importância da Ética e transparência em todas as atividades a serem desenvolvidas na TNC.

description:
Senior Manager, Legal Counsel

Department: Legal & Compliance

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counsel is responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27. This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

YOUR PROFILE

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Lending)
description:
About the Role

You will work closely with the product and credit teams to build go-to-market functions for our lending decisioning engine. You’ll debug and resolve complex issues independently, anticipate potential blockers, and help unblock others when needed.

You will evaluate scope and requirements critically by surfacing ambiguities early, challenging assumptions, and reframing trade-offs to ensure clarity before execution. Progress, risks, and blockers should be communicated proactively through tickets, stand-ups, and async updates to keep teammates and stakeholders aligned.

You will provide detailed peer reviews that improve code quality, maintainability, and extensibility. In addition, you’ll drive continuous improvement by identifying technical debt, proposing design or tooling enhancements, and sharing best practices that increase team velocity and reliability.

About the Team

The team develops Clutch's real-time lending decisioning engine. We work closely with Credit, Product, and Implementation teams to increase auto-decision rates and reduce funding time for our credit union partners. The team operates with a clear cadence and shared rituals, using narrative-driven planning and continuous improvement to ship reliably while collaborating across the broader Lending org.

Engineers own outcomes end to end, from discovery and decision-ready specs through rollout, monitoring, and follow-ups.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Debug and resolve issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Take ownership of smaller features end-to-end, from clarifying requirements to deployment.

  • Build working knowledge of decisioning engine features and rules, being able to explain their impact on the product.

  • Proactively ask questions, surface risks, and challenge assumptions early to improve clarity and scope of work.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Drive predictable delivery by proactively communicating progress, risks, and blockers without being prompted.

  • Confidently operate on lending decisioning context, making informed tradeoffs and documenting decisions.

  • Lead technical implementation for a feature or partner go-live, coordinating with stakeholders for alignment.

  • Anticipate potential problems in requirements or design, reframing them with data and alternative solutions before they become blockers.

  • Contribute high-quality code reviews that not only ensure standards, but also provide mentorship and elevate peers’ design and coding practices.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Lead and deliver a small-to-medium scoped project independently, including technical design, planning, and rollout.

  • Build trust with cross-functional and external stakeholders by representing engineering context and constraints clearly.

  • Proactively identify technical debt or process gaps and drive initiatives to resolve them with measurable impact.

  • Demonstrate readiness for the next level by consistently owning delivery, influencing peers, and shaping team practices that raise the overall bar.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong product-oriented mindset, able to connect technical decisions with business impact.

  • Proven ability to debug and resolve complex issues independently, providing clear root-cause analysis and documenting learnings.

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Credit, Implementation, and external stakeholders to align on scope and trade-offs.

  • Consistent ownership of small-to-medium projects end-to-end, from discovery and design to deployment and follow-up.

  • Ability to critically evaluate requirements, anticipate risks, and propose pragmatic alternatives that improve clarity and delivery outcomes.

  • Advanced English skills, both spoken and written.

  • Plus: previous experience with loan origination systems is a strong differentiator.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays: Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note: This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Product Director, Feegow (100% remote-friendly within Brazil)
description:
Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Additional Information

What will you get in return?

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

  • 100% remote-friendly within Brazil
  • Working hours are from Monday to Friday, from 9 am to 6 pm;
  • We have compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);
  • Food/Market Voucher;
  • Medical, Dental, and Group Life Insurance;
  • Pet Plan;
  • iFeel app, for emotional comfort;
  • Gympass for you and up to 3 people!
  • Creditas: Payroll loan services, eligible after 6 months of employment;
  • Stock Options- eligible after 6 months of employment (5 years grace period)
  • Birthday Day Off;
  • Daycare Assistance;
  • Partnership Club, with discounts ranging from teaching institutions, such as colleges and language learning services;
  • Referral Program offers up to R$600 per person who stays with us for more than 6 months;
  • Leave of Absence/Time-off: in the event of the passing of loved ones, we offer 10 days off; if your pet passes away, we offer 2 days. Got married? 7 days of rest! Did the baby arrive? We offer 30 days for Dads and 6 months for Moms;

description:
Overview

THE COMPANY: Juul Labs has a mission to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We focus on exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation, supported by leading technology investors. We are hiring great talent across engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations, customer service, and business professionals.

ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The Director, Cycle Planning is responsible for leading Juul Labs’ end-to-end commercial cycle planning process—translating strategic priorities into integrated, market-ready execution plans. This role ensures that product launches, promotions, consumer programs, and other commercial activities are strategically sequenced and operationally aligned to maximize business impact.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, the Director will partner with Sales, Brand, Go-to-Market (GTM), Demand Planning, and Operations to define objectives, set target metrics, and align tactical execution plans for each cycle. This includes managing dependencies, identifying risks and conflicts, and ensuring that all commercial activities are timed and resourced to deliver against volume, revenue, and market share goals. The Director will also serve as the central point of coordination for cycle planning inputs across the U.S. and International markets, ensuring integration with demand planning, resource allocation, and commercial governance processes.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the Commercial Cycle Planning Process
    • Own the development and management of JUUL Labs’ commercial cycle plans from strategy definition to execution readiness.
    • Partner with Commercial, Sales, and Brand leaders to set objectives, define KPIs, and prioritize activities within each cycle.
    • Integrate New Product Introductions (NPIs), promotions, and consumer programs into unified execution strategies that align with corporate and market priorities.
    • Maintain a forward-looking view of the cycle calendar to ensure proactive planning and risk mitigation.
  • Strategic Sequencing & Alignment
    • Facilitate cross-functional planning sessions to align activity sequencing for maximum commercial impact.
    • Identify and resolve conflicts, capacity constraints, and dependencies across initiatives.
    • Ensure cycle planning decisions consider operational lead times, regulatory requirements, and market readiness.
    • Partner with Demand Planning to ensure cycle strategies are supported by accurate forecasts and inventory availability.
  • Integration with Demand Planning & Governance
    • Ensure cycle plans are integrated into the broader commercial execution calendar and governance processes.
    • Collaborate with the demand planning team to align forecasts with cycle objectives and promotional plans.
    • Support the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO in preparing cycle planning updates for the Commercial Executive Team.
  • Planning Tools & Process Improvement
    • Maintain and evolve standardized cycle planning templates, tools, and workflows.
    • Drive process improvements to increase visibility, alignment, and execution efficiency across the commercial organization.
    • Partner with the PMO team to incorporate cycle planning milestones into initiative tracking dashboards.

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in commercial planning, marketing operations, or related commercial execution roles.
  • Proven experience managing integrated planning processes that span multiple functions and markets.
  • Strong facilitation and communication skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and drive consensus.
  • Ability to manage complex calendars and dependencies across product launches, promotions, and market programs.
  • Experience in CPG, nicotine/tobacco, or other regulated industries.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading Cycle Planning efforts in a commercial organization
  • Familiarity with enterprise planning tools and demand planning systems.
  • Experience integrating commercial planning with S&OP processes.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field.

  • A place to grow your career. We’ll help you set big goals - and exceed them
  • People. Work with talented, committed and supportive teammates
  • Equity and performance bonuses. Every employee is a stakeholder in our success

  • Excellent medical, dental and vision, disability, and life insurance, plus family support, wellness, legal, and employee assistance program benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Plus biannual discretionary performance bonuses

title: Head of Recovery Strategy, Process and Programs
description:
About Upstart

Upstart is the leading AI lending marketplace partnering with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit. By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while delivering the digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

The Recovery team at Upstart is responsible for maximizing post-default recoveries while ensuring compliant, borrower-centric engagement across a diverse and growing vendor ecosystem. As our Recovery operations mature, we are investing in building smarter, more scalable systems that reduce manual risk, improve data-driven decisions, and align our vendor network with long-term strategic outcomes.

We are seeking a Head of Recovery Strategy, Process & Programs to lead our transformation roadmap across vendor integration, automation, compliance infrastructure, and intelligent placement logic. This individual will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data Analytics, and Operations to architect the next evolution of Recovery operations at Upstart.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead Recovery’s transformation roadmap: Design and deliver high-impact initiatives that reduce manual risk, automate vendor workflows, and scale internal process efficiency across legal recovery, bankruptcy, affidavits, DSC, debt sales, and probate.
  • Architect scalable vendor infrastructure: Enhance frameworks for vendor onboarding, integration, compliance scorecards, and audit-readiness, ensuring Recovery is built to scale intelligently across a growing multi-vendor ecosystem.
  • Quantify and optimize placement strategy: Partner with data analytics, ML, and operations to improve liquidation and cost-to-collect through segmentation logic, hypothesis-driven testing, and performance-based routing.
  • Drive analytical and cross-functional execution: Lead strategic programs from concept to implementation—including the rollout of tools like Convoke, legal collections testing, and compliance health models—grounded in measurable ROI and portfolio-level impact.
  • Own Recovery’s strategic alignment layer: Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Legal, ML, and Ops to ensure programs are modeled, implemented, and monitored with discipline.
  • Enable performance & quality execution, not manage it: This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You'll complement operational leadership by enabling managers with scalable tools, systems, and decision frameworks—not by running day-to-day vendor performance.

title: Technical Product Owner – FinTech
description:
Overview

Ruby Labs is looking for a Technical Product Owner to lead the development and rollout of the Payment Orchestration System. This role is central to aligning engineering and integration efforts with our product strategy for payments and billing in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of the Payment Orchestration System MVP by coordinating the integration and implementation of new payment service providers, aligning technical initiatives with product strategy.
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, translating business needs and stakeholder goals into clear, actionable user stories that guide engineering and integration teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Integration, Architecture, and the Head of Payments & Billing to ensure timely, high-quality delivery across the payments ecosystem.
  • Define and adapt Agile workflows (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid) to fit team dynamics, driving efficiency through daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Manage and track work progress, ensuring transparency, accountability, and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain up-to-date product documentation, technical specifications, and decision records to foster alignment and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on progress, risks, and delivery timelines.
  • Champion Agile and product management best practices to continuously improve team performance, product quality, and customer value delivery.
  • Support QA and UAT efforts to ensure reliability and compliance of payment and billing subsystems.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives as needed, supporting broader product and organizational goals.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager, preferably in fintech, payments, billing, or SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, including PSPs, payment orchestration, billing flows, and integration models.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, including ability to read API documentation, understand request/response cycles, and collaborate with engineers on interface definitions.
  • Familiarity with SDKs and developer tools; capable of supporting integration efforts and assessing third-party SDK capabilities.
  • Basic programming/scripting knowledge (e.g. JavaScript, Python, or similar) to support technical discussions, perform lightweight testing, or work with tools like Postman and Swagger.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid models); ability to lead Agile ceremonies and continuously improve team workflows.
  • Proficiency with product and project management tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, Plane.so, Outline).
  • Ability to write clear and concise user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, especially Engineering, Architecture, QA, and external partners.
  • Prior experience with PCI compliance, fraud prevention, or billing automation in a product context.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and data analysis tools (e.g. Looker, SQL) for product insights and validation.
  • Previous involvement in system migrations, particularly payment infrastructure transitions or tool replacements.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply as long as they are located within approximately ±4 hours of CET to ensure optimal collaboration during working hours.

Benefits

  • Remote Work Environment: Work from anywhere to support work-life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO: Unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize well-being.
  • Paid National Holidays: Paid time off on national holidays.
  • Company-provided MacBook: Equipment provided as needed.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Autonomy and flexibility with related benefits.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screening (approx. 40 minutes)
  • First Interview (approx. 35 minutes)
  • Final Interview (approx. 45 minutes)

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We seek ambitious, driven individuals who want to grow and make an impact.

title: State Growth Lead- Remote
description:
State Growth Lead – State & Local Government Initiative

Location: Remote (U.S.-based) | Preferred: Florida | Travel: Moderate travel required to client sites, conferences, and ICF offices

About the Role

ICF is hiring State Growth Leads to join our Energy, Environment, and Infrastructure (EEI) Group and help expand our presence in the State and Local Government market across high-priority states. Our multidisciplinary teams serve clients across climate resilience, disaster recovery, energy efficiency, infrastructure, transportation, and environmental planning. This is an exciting time to join ICF, as public-sector funding for state and local climate and infrastructure solutions continues to grow.

As a State Growth Lead, you will drive proactive growth strategies in focused states. You’ll be responsible for building a robust pipeline, developing strategic relationships, and securing high-value contracts with government agencies. You will work closely with subject matter experts, proposal teams, marketing, and delivery staff to pursue opportunities that align with ICF’s core capabilities and values.

This is a high-impact role with autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to shape how ICF partners with state and local agencies on some of the most pressing issues of our time.

Why you will love working here

  • Quality of life: Flexible workplace arrangements, work-life balance
  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities
  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

What you will be doing

Month 1 Expectations

  • Understand ICF’s capabilities across Disaster Management (DM); Climate, Energy, and Transportation (CET); environmental planning (E&P); and Utility Programs and Services (UPS).
  • Learn ICF’s business development and capture management processes.
  • Meet with key leaders across BD, Delivery, and Marketing teams.
  • Build a landscape of your assigned state: agencies, priorities, funding flows, and recent awards.
  • In collaboration with delivery leads, identify initial pipeline targets and key client relationships.

First 6 Months Expectations

  • Build a qualified pipeline of at least $50M in identified or anticipated opportunities.
  • Actively lead at least five pursuits across your assigned region.
  • Develop win strategies and lead opportunity shaping efforts.
  • Attend relevant conferences, industry events, and client briefings.
  • Review competitive proposals.
  • Identify and negotiate teaming relationships with local partners or primes.
  • Actively engage with key ICF stakeholders across all four EEI lines of business.

12–18 Month Expectations

  • Close new business totaling $20M+ in contract value.
  • Contribute to statewide or regional growth strategy planning efforts.
  • Co-develop state-specific marketing campaigns with support from ICF’s marketing team.
  • Develop value propositions and pursuit playbooks for recurring opportunity types.
  • Champion cross-ICF collaboration and alignment between technical and BD teams.
  • Maintain accurate CRM updates, forecasts, and pursuit documentation.

Minimum qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 10+ years of business development or capture experience in the public sector, preferably state and local markets.
  • 3+ years of experience using structured capture processes (e.g., Shipley, APMP, MEDPICC, etc.).

Preferred skills

  • Background in one or more of the following sectors: climate adaptation, disaster recovery, infrastructure, transportation, energy efficiency, or environmental consulting.
  • Track record of leading and winning pursuits of $10M+ in total contract value.
  • Demonstrated understanding of government funding and procurement cycles at the state and local level.
  • Experience working with or for a state agency, city government, or county government.
  • Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., APMP, CPCM) preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM and pipeline tools (e.g., Dynamics, Salesforce).

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future. We can only solve the world’s toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

A Concessionária

A Águas do Rio, concessionária da Aegea é responsável pelo abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário em 27 municípios do estado do Rio de Janeiro, incluindo 124 bairros da capital, atendendo 10 milhões de pessoas.

Durante o período de concessão, iniciado em 1º de novembro de 2021, a companhia realizou o maior investimento em saneamento básico no país, em torno de R$ 39 bilhões. R$ 15,4 bilhões em outorga, para serem aplicados em projetos prioritários dos governos estadual e municipais, e R$ 24,4 bilhões para a universalização dos serviços de água e esgoto, que será alcançada nos primeiros 12 anos, em alinhamento ao novo Marco Regulatório de Saneamento.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com apromoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Overview

What You Will Do

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Manager of Collaboration to lead our team and oversee our collaboration tools and technologies. This role is not just about maintaining our existing systems; it's about defining what "best-in-class" collaboration looks like for our organization and driving us toward that vision. You will lead our internal team of collaboration engineers and oversee our third-party support provider. Your role is to manage this vendor relationship, ensuring they meet our high standards for service delivery and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Strategy and Leadership: Develop and execute a strategic roadmap for our collaboration technology stack, aligning with business goals and future growth. Lead, mentor, and manage a team of internal collaboration engineers and specialists. Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in the collaboration space, evaluating and recommending new solutions.
  • Defining and Delivering Best-in-Class Collaboration: Act as the primary champion for a "best-in-class" collaboration strategy, focusing on user experience, security, and productivity. Develop and implement governance policies and a "right tool for the job" framework to guide employees on when to use email, instant messaging, or video conferencing. Proactively identify and implement features within our existing tools (Google Workspace, Zoom, MS Exchange) to maximize their value and enhance team efficiency. Foster a culture of effective communication and collaboration, working with stakeholders to optimize workflows and reduce communication overload.
  • Vendor and Service Delivery Management: Serve as the primary point of contact and accountability for our outsourced support provider. Define, monitor, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure the vendor meets performance targets. Conduct regular business reviews with the vendor to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and ensure alignment with our strategic goals. Act as the escalation point for major issues and work closely with the vendor to ensure timely and effective resolution.
  • Security & Governance: Partner with our internal security team to manage and enforce security policies across all collaboration platforms. Oversee email security, data governance, and user access controls to protect sensitive information.
  • Platform Management: Administer and manage our Google Workspace environment, including Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Meet. Oversee the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of our Zoom platform for meetings, webinars, and room systems. Manage and support our on-premises Microsoft Exchange servers, ensuring high availability and seamless integration with other systems. Maintain and support our conference room technologies, including Logitech kits, Chromeboxes, and Q-Sys audio/video solutions.
  • User Experience and Training: Develop and deliver training programs and documentation to empower users to effectively use collaboration tools. Gather user feedback to identify areas for improvement and work with the outsourced provider to address gaps and drive a better user experience.
  • Project Management: Lead collaboration-related projects, from initial planning and requirements gathering to implementation and post-deployment support. Manage budgets and resources for the collaboration team and related projects.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong knowledge of Google Workspace administration and management.
  • 5+ years of experience in managing collaboration technologies in an enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience in vendor management , including negotiating contracts and managing service delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of Zoom administration, including Zoom Rooms and API integrations.
  • Experience with Microsoft Exchange Server administration and hybrid environments.
  • Solid understanding of conference room technologies, including A/V systems, video conferencing hardware (Logitech, Chromeboxes ), and audio processing platforms (Q-Sys).
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Workspace Administrator, Zoom Certified Professional) are a plus.

What You Will Need

Education:

  • High School diploma equivalency with 3 years of cumulative experience OR Associate'sdegree/Bachelor's degree with 2 years of cumulative experience OR 7 years of applicable cumulative job specific experience required.
  • 3 years of leadership or management experience preferred.

Additional Preferences

No additional preferences.

title: Revenue Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Overview

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Revenue Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our sales strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy —including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor sales productivity, forecast accuracy, CAC payback, and other core SaaS KPIs; conduct deeper analysis using Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects , delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements

  • 3–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations , preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus | SQL, Python is a plus ).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, sales cycles, and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field .

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth .
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture .
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Application

This position is exclusively for Brazil-based engineering talent on a CLT contract paid in BRL. Relocation will not be considered at this time.

You will be required to speak English daily in written and verbal communication with our global (Brazil and U.S. team).

title: Scaled Customer Manager - On Demand
description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you\'ll do

As the Scaled Customer Manager, you are an extension of the Customer Success Account Management (CSAM) team that oversees an incoming queue of requests. Their primary function is to connect customers with the right resources, ensuring an outstanding customer experience as measured by NPS, net revenue retention, referrals, and product usage indicators. The Scaled Customer Manager performs just-in-time tactical account management activities. They will collaborate with other team members to coordinate successful customer engagement, product enablement, and demonstrate value across the entire customer journey.

This position is an individual contributor reporting to the Manager, Scaled Customer Management.

Responsibility
  • Monitor and manage a high volume of customer inquiries through digital channels
  • Triage requests by routing to the appropriate internal teams or providing self-service content; escalate patterns or systemic issues as needed
  • Create and assign CTAs (Call To Actions) to On-Demand 1:1 Specialists or other internal stakeholders
  • Respond to customers with clear, friendly, and accurate email communication that addresses immediate needs and encourages 1:1 engagement when appropriate
  • Track and document engagement outcomes in Salesforce or Gainsight
  • Maintain and contribute to a response library and create reusable content for recurring inquiries
  • Collaborate with Digital and On Demand SCMs, Support, Product, and CS teams to ensure aligned messaging and coordinated engagement
  • Support KPIs related to CSAT, retention, and resolution time through effective queue management and triage execution
  • Continuously develop product knowledge to guide customers effectively and contribute to scalable digital workflows
  • Identify insights and opportunities from customer interactions to inform proactive strategies and improve team processes
  • Maintain accountability for your digital queue, executing tasks with accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position\'s job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • 2+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, preferably in Customer Success, Support, or Account Management
  • Experience managing high volumes of customer inquiries via digital channels such as email, web forms, or CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Gainsight)
  • Experience documenting and tracking customer interactions and outcomes in CRM or engagement platforms
  • Experience identifying patterns in customer feedback and escalating issues appropriately

Preferred

  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to craft clear, professional, and customer-friendly responses
  • Ability to triage customer needs effectively by routing to internal resources or providing relevant self-help content
  • Demonstrated ability to identify trends from customer inquiries and contribute to content development or response libraries
  • Experience creating or maintaining self-service resources, knowledge base articles, or email response templates
  • Understanding of customer lifecycle stages and how to drive adoption through digital touchpoints
  • Proven ability to collaborate across functions (e.g., Product, Marketing, Support, Sales) to align on messaging and resolve customer needs
  • Strong attention to detail with experience managing multiple tasks or workflows in a fast-paced environment
  • Highly organized and able to manage a digital task queue with accuracy, timeliness, and attention to detail
  • Comfortable collaborating across teams, including Customer Success, Product, Support, and Sales, to ensure aligned messaging and support
  • Proactive, adaptable, and able to contribute to process improvements in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Willingness to continuously build product knowledge to support effective customer guidance and triage decisions

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

description:
Overview

Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users\' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting-edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where everyone\'s opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high-quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

Responsibilities

  • Managing Google Ads Campaigns: Launch, monitor, and optimize campaigns across Search, Display, and Video.
  • Bottom-of-Funnel Focus: Prioritize conversions that go beyond lead generation, including SQLs, pipeline impact, and closed-won revenue.
  • Collaboration with Sales Teams: Partner closely with sales to align on lead quality, refine campaign targeting, and maintain a strong feedback loop.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting: Create dashboards and evaluate campaign results using Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and spreadsheets.
  • Full-Funnel & Lead Quality Insights: Deep knowledge of the buyer journey and how paid media influences progression through the funnel.
  • A/B Testing & Creative Iteration: Conduct A/B tests on targeting, ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding tactics to drive performance gains.
  • Cross-Channel Integration: Collaborate with the broader marketing team to maintain cohesive messaging and strategic alignment across all channels.
  • Landing Page & CRO Collaboration: Coordinate with design teams to enhance landing page effectiveness and improve conversion rates.
  • Budget Management & Forecasting: Manage spend pacing and performance targets, with clear reporting on ROI and CAC.
  • Platform Expansion: Research and experiment with emerging ad formats and placements within the Google Ads platform.

Experience we\'re looking for

  • Expertise in Google Ads: Over 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid campaigns across Google Search, Display, and Video.
  • Full-Funnel Focus: Skilled in tracking and optimizing campaigns beyond top-of-funnel leads, with an emphasis on driving revenue.
  • Strong Analytical Abilities: Proficiency in using Google Analytics, spreadsheets, Looker Studio (or similar tools), and analyzing campaign performance data.
  • Collaboration with Sales: Proven experience partnering with sales teams to enhance campaign impact on the sales pipeline.
  • Advanced Conversion Tracking: Knowledgeable in UTM parameters, pixel setup, and using Google Tag Manager for tracking.
  • Proficient in English: Effective in communicating and collaborating in English across teams and documentation.
  • CRM Awareness: Understanding of how paid media campaigns connect with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.

What we’re looking for this role to achieve

  • Drive higher revenue attributed to marketing through Google Ads campaigns.
  • Enhance SQL rates and boost lead-to-deal conversions via paid media channels.
  • Develop a collaborative workflow with the sales team to assess and refine lead quality.
  • Lower cost per acquisition (CPA) while improving return on ad spend (ROAS) and customer acquisition cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Expand a full-funnel paid media strategy aligned with customer purchasing behaviors.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

If you’re eager to be part of an exciting, challenging, and rapidly growing consultancy, we encourage you to apply. #LI-Remote

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.
